hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: A_G0002 = F(x); A_G0003 = F(y); A_G0001 = (F(x)-F(y))/(x-y), the first Newton divided difference of F at nodes x,y.
required_assumptions: x != y for the divided-difference reconstruction in G0001
polygamma(0, t) is defined at t = x and t = y
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The three catalog expressions are point evaluations and the first divided difference of the same latent digamma function F(t)=polygamma(0,t). G0002 and G0003 are substitutions of the latent variable t by x and y, while G0001 is obtained by the first Newton divided difference on nodes x and y.
